annotations.title: Check whether a user is subscribed

description: The authoritative paid/not-paid verdict for one user, unified across Stripe, RevenueCat, App Store and Play — the same answer GET /api/v1/entitlements/{user_id} returns to a server. Note: `environment` is SANDBOX when the verdict rests on test purchases, so always check it before granting production access; a cancellation only flips will_renew (access runs to expires_at); and an unknown user is a valid 'none' answer, not an error.

user_id.description: Device id, account id or RevenueCat id
